max_acquisitions.basis: one capture runs at a time; a small table holds queued starts, undelivered attempts and reference outcomes until their lifetime ends; a table full of undelivered attempts refuses new starts as busy

max_frames.basis: per camera: a 40 s window at 60 frames per second; longer captures are cut, never extended

max_devices.basis: a laptop webcam plus a three camera station (docs/product/api/examples/clinical/measurement-request-pulse.json notes three cameras)

delivery_backoff_ms.basis: first wait before an undelivered attempt is sent again with the same Idempotency-Key; doubles after every failed try (SYSTEM 5.11 workers row: retries indefinitely at bounded rate)

delivery_backoff_max_ms.basis: longest wait between deliveries, the hub's own restart backoff cap (SYSTEM 3 hub row: backoff 1 s doubling to 30 s), so a returning hub gets the attempt within one of its restart steps

max_ttl_ms.basis: a reference window or measurement lives at most ten minutes (E20 restart window, docs/tdd/E20.md:485); the worker reports it in describe and the hub never asks for more

hub_timeout_ms.basis: every call into the hub is bounded (SYSTEM section 3 footer); five seconds matches the health interval

runner_idle_ms.basis: runner poll interval when no acquisition is waiting

max_body_bytes.basis: largest start body read (the protocol's start has fixed fields and at most 16 camera IDs); bounded buffer per AGENTS 3.2

camera_timeout_ms.basis: every connect to and read from a camera is bounded (AGENTS 3.2); a stream silent this long has dropped, which is ten frame intervals of a 3 frames per second camera
